newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian sugar prices recover on fresh demand.
newsitem.headline: Indian sugar prices recover on fresh demand.

text.p: Sugar prices recovered on Tuesday on fresh consumer buying and reduced supplies, traders said.
Ready sugar S-30 recovered some of its lost ground by 10/25 rupees to 1,300/1,350 rupees per quintal and M-30 rose 10/15 rupees to 1,365/1,425 rupees per quintal.
"Arrivals of sugar from mills to the Bombay market/ remained low today at 40/50 truckloads against a daily average of 80/100 truckloads," one broker said.
Sugar mill delivery rose 25/30 rupees to 1,240/1,260 rupees per quintal following higher demand from other centres.
Overall sentiment was firm at close, traders said.
The Bombay sugar market will remain closed on Wednesday for a Hindu festival. It will reopen for trading on Thursday.
